content.text:
Two wake-ups at 19 months is common but fixable -- the usual move is to stretch the time before you respond, adding a minute or two each night so Remy learns to resettle without you. A consistent pre-sleep routine (same order, same cues every night) is the other piece that makes the fastest difference.

Want the full night-by-night sleep plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
